bosses.name: Golden Bat
bosses.strategy:
He says you have 5 turns to defeat him before he obliterates Keith, but
you technically have 6.

It's not hard to succeed, but if you miss some hits, you could be in
trouble. Keith can only attack normally, so just keep doing that. It
should only take three turns max, unless you didn't equip the Mind's Eye,
then it'll probably take all six.

If you're having a hard time with this battle, then level Keith up to
where he can definitely deal 1500 damage within four or five turns, to be
safe.

NOTE     Even though you already have it equipped for this battle, the
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   reward for winning is the DemonSwd-Tyrving......

Before going to the Blue Castle, we need to trigger the event in Bistritz.


   Bistritz
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Head over to the eastern side of town and head into Nina's house. Nina will
inform Keith of something she saw in the Blue Castle, which will now let you
continue with the event there, so head over to the Blue Castle.


   Blue Castle
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Head inside the castle, then go north up to the Save Point. Take the western
path, follow it around and down to the basement with the caskets. Approach the
open casket to find a Golden Bat! It's actually Keith's brother, and he'll give
him the [_DEMONSWD-TYRVING_]. You'll then have to face him as Keith (alone) to
earn it!

Another scene will follow afterward. When you regain control, head back
upstairs and leave the Blue Castle entirely.

Switch Keith out of your party with someone else, then return to Blue Castle.
If Keith's in your party, then the next Lottery Member will not appear.

Make your way into the Castle and to the Save Point. SAVE, then head down the
eastern stairs and make your way to the throne room where you first met Keith.
There will be an invisible man here, much like Keith; talk to him, and he'll
become the Vice Chairman (Lottery Member No. 01)!

           ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

The ring here is INSANELY FAST, and there's no way to slow it down, so good
luck! Make sure to win the Thief Earrings before continuing on; it's like the
Brigand and Pirate Earrings combined, with no downfall! They'll allow you to
get a 20% higher chance at treasure after battle, as well as 20% more Cash! If
you don't win it, reload your last save and try again. Remember, you need to
win something from each member at least once!

That's it for here. On to the next quest!
